headlines.title: Trump administration cuts ACA coverage for 750,000 people it says were ‘fraudulently’ enrolled
headlines.description: The Trump administration is removing hundreds of thousands of enrollees from Obamacare plans, claiming that many were receiving subsidies they didn’t qualify for and that some did not even exist.

headlines.title: Thousands removed from ACA coverage in effort to crack down on alleged fraud
headlines.description: Vice President JD Vance announced a plan to remove about 750,000 people from Affordable Care Act plans in an effort to crack down on alleged healthcare fraud. NBC News’ Garrett Haake details why the administration is doing this now.

headlines.title: Expert Tips for Thriving While on GLP-1 Medications
headlines.description: Heidi Skolnik, a sports nutritionist, exercise physiologist and bestselling author, joins TODAY to discuss her latest book, “Your GLP-1 Game Plan,” that is filled with guidance on what to eat and how to move and thrive on weight loss medications. “The medication doesn’t give you nourishment, and it doesn’t give you strength. You really need to go beyond the scale to think about your ‘why.’ And we know that when you focus on health beyond appearance, you do better,” she says.

headlines.title: Hundreds of lawsuits filed against some GLP-1 Makers over vision loss
headlines.description: Hundreds of Americans are suing GLP-1 drugmakers Novo Nordisk and Ely Lilly, saying they were not adequately warned of the potential danger of vision loss. In statements, Novo Nordisk says, in part, they are “vigorously” fighting the lawsuits, saying they are “without merit,” while Eli Lilly says in part, it maintains “patient safety” is its “top priority.” NBC News’ Stephanie Gosk has the story.

headlines.title: The best editor-approved planners and agendas for even the busiest schedules
headlines.description: I rounded up some of the best planners and agendas to help you get organized this year, complete with calendars, to-do lists and more.

headlines.title: October Prime vacuum deals have already started — these 17 are up to 50% off
headlines.description: I found the best early vacuum deals from Prime Big Deal Days, also known as October Prime Day. Shops deals from Dyson, Shark, Bissell and other staff favorites.

headlines.title: Prime Day hasn’t started but Amazon already has Apple deals you don’t want to miss
headlines.description: NBC Selected editors are tracking the best prices on AirPods, Apple Watches, iPads, MacBooks and other Apple products.

headlines.title: October Prime Day starts in a few weeks, but these can’t-miss beauty deals are already live
headlines.description: Expert-vetted discounts on skin care, hair care, makeup and beauty tools worth shopping early.

headlines.title: Drinking finally slows after pandemic spike, but not for every age group
headlines.description: Americans are drinking less for the first time since the pandemic, but alcohol use remains higher than it was before 2020, according to a study published Monday in the journal Annals of Internal Medicine.

headlines.title: CDC’s teen behavior report focuses on nutrition, downplays sex and drug use
headlines.description: The new CDC report on teen health focused on high schoolers playing sports and making healthier food choices, priorities for Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr.

headlines.title: The first mRNA flu shot is now available. Here’s who can get it.
headlines.description: People looking to get their annual flu shot this fall may find a new option alongside the usual vaccines: an mRNA flu shot. Not everyone is eligible, however.
